column4: an owner-scoped, budgeted store of immutable classfile-BYTE candidates: one byte[] arena with int offset / length / chain lanes and a packed SHA-256 lane; SHA-256 selects candidates, full bytes decide equality; owner-local int ordinals; plus an immutable integrity-framed archive of one owner (M3CSIMG1) and a read-only constant-pool scanner that interns raw CONSTANT_Utf8 bytes. column4: MIndexClassPool is an append-only arena of Java class METADATA (binary / package / module name handles in a MatIndexStringPool text pool, modifiers, supertypes, interface and member tables, identity / exact / structural / logic / SimHash lanes) and MIndexClassIndex its primitive lookup index (findClass / findMember / methodsNamed); M3ClassSpace interns opaque immutable classfile BYTES under a byte budget. No shared shape (no text pool, no member model, no byte-image budget on the other side)

column4: same core shape (owner-scoped exact-byte intern, copy, count, retained bytes) but different contracts: FNV-1a 64 hash vs a 32-byte SHA-256 lane exposed through digestHex; long handles vs int ordinals; no budget vs a fail-closed maxBytes with duplicate lookup before the budget check; freezable store vs failure-atomic growth (every lane prepared before publication: the fault probe); no region / batch admission vs internRegion and the all-or-nothing internUtf8Batch; M3IS stream vs the M3CSIMG1 frame
column6: equivalence not decided: both kept, side by side in the one owner module; convergence (for example ByteStore adopting the budget and failure-atomic growth, or M3ClassSpace layered on ByteStore) is a proposal for a later leaf with its own differential, not done here

column6: both kept (no wire format changes); proposal only
